title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python / Go / AWS)
description:
We are seeking a Backend Engineer with 3+ years of experience in Python and Go to build high-scale microservices. Requirements:
- Strong proficiency with Python, FastAPI, or Django.
- Experience designing relational schemas in PostgreSQL and in-memory caches like Redis.
- Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS cloud services (EC2, S3, RDS).
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing with pytest, and RESTful API architecture.
- Experience with distributed streaming systems such as Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ is a strong plus.

title: Data Analyst (SQL / BI / Product Analytics)
description:
Acme Corp is hiring a Data Analyst to join our Product Analytics team. In this role, you will:
- Write advanced SQL queries across Snowflake and BigQuery data warehouses.
- Build interactive dashboards in Tableau and Power BI for executive leadership.
- Conduct A/B testing and statistical analysis using Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scipy) or R.
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to define KPIs and analyze customer retention and churn.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (NLP / PyTorch / Transformers)
description:
Join our AI research and applied engineering team. Requirements:
- M.S. or B.S. in Computer Science or related quantitative field.
- Proven expertise in PyTorch or TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, and NLP libraries (spaCy, NLTK).
- Experience training, fine-tuning, and evaluating transformer models on text classification and entity recognition tasks.
- Practical knowledge of Docker containerization and model deployment pipelines.
- Solid understanding of ML evaluation metrics, loss functions, and dataset curation.

title: Frontend Engineer (React / TypeScript / Next.js)
description:
We are looking for a passionate Frontend Engineer to craft fast and accessible web apps. Key responsibilities:
- Build web interfaces using React, TypeScript, Next.js, and modern CSS frameworks like Tailwind CSS.
- Maintain and evolve component design systems with an emphasis on WCAG accessibility compliance.
- Write comprehensive client-side unit and integration tests using Jest and Cypress.
- Work closely with backend teams on REST and GraphQL API integrations.
